title: Audio Memo Delegated Event
description: A driver-confirmed brief from the fast in-car conversation layer was dispatched to an agent (one event per confirmed brief). Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

target_agent_id.description: Agent the memo was addressed to (the inbox/<agent>/ prefix).

conv_id.description: Id of the fast in-car conversation session this memo belongs to.

tile_agent_id.description: The agent whose tile the driver was talking to; the brief belongs to this conversation.

brief_id.description: uuid5 id of the confirmed brief.

brief_sha256.description: sha256 of the brief text exactly as dispatched.

command_id.description: uuid5(brief_id): command_id of the agent invocation that carries the brief.

lane.description: Hermes gateway lane the brief was dispatched on (batch by default).

perm.description: Permission level of the dispatched brief, clamped by what the driver said.
